messages:
sara: Evening async standup — quick updates from my side: landed slot allocator fix in kernel (PR #4123). p95 down ~8ms on short-seq perf. dashboard -> http://perf/redwood/slot-alloc :tada:
ben: Nice! Did you run the microburst suite? Any regressions on long sequences?
sara: Ran microburst + e2e with batching=auto. No regressions on long seqs. Noted a small CPU bump in one config, snippet: ```
- cpu: 72%
+ cpu: 78%
```
kai: Heads up — KV cache evictions still spike on shard-7 during the backfill window. Bisecting canary configs now.
priya: Assigning triage: @kai + @sara. If evictions trace to the allocator change we should pause the canary.
kai: I don't think it's allocator-only. Eviction heat correlates with background snapshot job (nightly). Added log line: `kv.evictions=43 -> triggered by snapshot_flush`
mike: Quick ask: anyone free to review my batching heuristics PR (#4140)? Small change to slot packing, needs a perf eyeball.
ben: I can take it in the morning. Leave a perf/trace link and I'll run the microburst locally.
sara: I can skim tonight — will focus on correctness and a couple of nits.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started 2026-03-18T19:02 by sara for kernel v0.9.12 (canary=10%)
priya: Blocker note: need clear rollback automation if eviction rate spikes. @ops-bot can we auto-fallback to v0.9.11 on >=5% eviction rate?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Auto-fallback rule not configured for this service. Please open an ops ticket to request policy.
priya: Filed ops ticket RED-987: https://tickets/redwood/RED-987. Adding runbook + screenshots.
kai: Plan for tonight: continue bisect, check snapshot scheduling, instrument kv for per-key latency, and hold canary if >3 evictions/min observed.
sara: Today: finish PR review, help kai with log plumbing, run another microburst with kv instrumentation and post results here.
ben: FYI I'll re-run long-seq bench with batching=manual and attach traces tomorrow morning.
mike: Thanks team — leaving my PR link here: http://git/redwood/pr/4140 and a short perf trace: http://perf/redwood/trace/4140
priya: Thanks all. If anyone sees a hard regression ping the oncall and add `#eviction` tag to the ticket. Good night! :wave:
